subtitle: Design Project III(Tsukegi Takayuki)
keywords: Composite materials 2.Recycling engineering 3.Polymer chemistry 4.Biomass materials 5.Cluster studies
educationalGoal: Using familiar biomass-derived polymers to understand environmental recycling materials. Be able to adopt the concept of a circular economy and work on research while understanding the trends of the world. It is possible to introduce universal design and work on sustainable and safe manufacturing. To be able to experience, understand, and put into practice the research objectives of Project Design III. Opportunities to publish research results inside and outside the university.
advice: Using biomass-derived plastics and fibers, we are promoting research and development of environment-recycling composite materials. Linear Economy (Creating → Use → Disposal), adopting the concept of circular economy (circular economy) and aiming to reduce waste as much as possible doing. We will collect materials after use, introduce a universal design that assumes a recyclable structure, and create a sustainable and safe environment. We will work on manufacturing. ○Students (graduate students and undergraduate students) take the lead in conducting seminars. Presents research results twice a month. ○In our laboratory, we actively publish our research results through domestic and international conferences, peer-reviewed papers, specialized journals, and patents. Cluster studies We are developing distinctive research and promoting cross-disciplinary research (chemistry, machinery, robots, design, etc.) by forming a joint research system. We will strengthen collaboration with different fields, companies, and universities, and proceed with incisive research from various perspectives.
